text: I need to see Dr. Salem next Tuesday morning
notes: No exact time given, only a period; intake should either ask for clarification or default to first available morning slot per skill-pack rule.

text: Can I book an appointment with Dr. Chen for this Friday at 3pm?
notes: Fully specified except patient name; should still validate cleanly if patient_name is not a required field, or trigger missing-field PENDING_APPROVAL if it is.

text: book me in with the doctor tomorrow
notes: No named practitioner — required_fields violation, should return PENDING_APPROVAL with reason referencing missing practitioner.

text: Need a checkup sometime next week
notes: Practitioner and exact date/time all unresolved; good stress-test for how many missing-field reasons get reported at once.

text: Dr Salem 9am monday pls
notes: Terse/typo'd phrasing; tests intake robustness to missing punctuation and informal register.

text: I'd like an appointment with Dr. Amara at 7am on Wednesday
notes: Assumes clinic working hours start later (e.g. 09:00); should parse cleanly but be rejected by the approval gate as PENDING_APPROVAL(outside_working_hours), not by intake itself.

text: My son needs to see Dr. Lee, is 2pm Thursday free?
notes: patient_name is a reference, not a name; tests whether intake flags this as needing clarification rather than literally storing 'my son'.

text: urgent - need to see any available doctor today
notes: No specific practitioner requested at all (any doctor); tests whether the skill pack supports an 'unassigned practitioner' path or must reject as missing_field.

text: reschedule my appointment with Dr. Salem to next Tuesday 10am
notes: Reschedule/cancel actions are out of scope for this prototype (booking only); intake should either reject cleanly or map to a new booking, but must not silently misinterpret it as a fresh, unrelated appointment.

text: Dr. Salem, patient Ahmed Omer, Tuesday 10:30am, annual physical
notes: Fully specified, list-like phrasing rather than a natural sentence; tests parser robustness to non-prose input.

text: Dr. B this Thursday 14:30, patient Maria Lopez
notes: Exercises two patterns untested by the original 10: 24-hour clock time (_TIME_24H_RE) and the 'this <weekday>' date qualifier (_THIS_WEEKDAY_RE).

text: dr chen tomorrow 9am, patient Wes Ford
notes: The practitioner regex is case-insensitive and treats '.' as optional, so 'dr chen' DOES extract cleanly to 'Dr. Chen' -- intake succeeds. 'Chen' is not in the default {Dr. A, Dr. B} roster, so this is expected to fail downstream at ClinicSkillPack.validate() as 'unknown practitioner', not at intake. patient_name omitted: no literal 'patient <Name>' phrase present.

text: Dr. Van Der Berg tomorrow 10am, patient John Doe
notes: Documents a real parser limitation: _PRACTITIONER_RE captures only a single word token after 'Dr.', so a multi-word surname is silently truncated to 'Dr. Van', not 'Dr. Van Der Berg'. Worth a DESIGN.md/known-gaps mention if multi-word surnames matter for a future sector.

text: Dr. A tonight 6pm, patient James Bond
notes: A second out-of-hours case using 'tonight' (resolves via _TODAY_TONIGHT_RE) + 6pm, distinct phrasing from the original out-of-hours example (clinic-06's 7am/Wednesday). Parses cleanly; rejected by the approval gate, not intake.

text: cancel my appointment with Dr. A
notes: Covers the 'cancel' branch of _ACTION_RE (clinic-09 only covered 'reschedule'). No date/time given at all, so start_time is correctly never assembled.

text: Dr. A Friday 11am, patient Tom Reed
notes: A bare weekday with no 'this'/'next' qualifier -- exercises _BARE_WEEKDAY_RE, the last-priority date pattern, untested by the original 10 (which only used 'next Tuesday', 'tomorrow', 'today').

text: Dr. B sometime next month, patient Lucy Grey
notes: 'next month' is outside the parser's date vocabulary (only weekday names + today/tomorrow/tonight resolve) -- correctly omitted rather than guessed, per the offline parser's own 'omit, don't guess' contract. A second, distinct unresolvable-date case from clinic-04's 'sometime next week'.

text: Dr. A this Monday afternoon, patient Nora Kim
notes: A vague time-of-day word ('afternoon') is carried as a separate time_period hint, never converted into a clock time -- so start_time is correctly never assembled (needs BOTH an exact time and a date per _extract_start_time).

text: Dr. B tomorrow 3pm, patient Ana Maria Torres
notes: _PATIENT_NAME_RE captures at most two capitalized words after 'patient' -- a three-word name is truncated to 'Ana Maria', dropping 'Torres'. A second documented extraction-truncation limitation, this time on patient_name rather than practitioner.

text: Dr. A tomorrow 17:00, patient Ben Fox
notes: Exactly at the clinic's configured close time. ClinicSkillPack.validate() treats close as exclusive (open <= t < close), so 17:00 itself is out of hours -- a precise boundary case for the working-hours check, complementing clinic-06's clearly-before-open case.
